environment: Chromium browser with 390 x 844 mobile viewport and fractional device scale
method: Native header clicks, rendered DOM inspection, and semantic paragraph/progress comparison at the reading line below the sticky header

courses.reading_point: Section 8, paragraph about the KV cache
Step 2.3.2, paragraph about practical Monte Carlo estimators
Temperature as a trade-off parameter, paragraph below the numerical table

scenarios_per_course: RU to EN to RU with both menus closed
Open modules menu, RU to EN to RU, close menu
Open lecture outline, RU to EN to RU, close outline
assertions: The corresponding translated paragraph remains at the reading line
Progress within the paragraph differs by less than one percentage point
Both menu expanded/collapsed states survive language switches
Background remains locked while a menu is open and unlocks when closed
Opening and closing menus preserve the reading column width and paragraph position
fix: Reserve the root scrollbar gutter while scrolling is locked; compensate any remaining gutter with its measured fractional width for browsers without stable gutter support.
